findings.detail: The flagged seven-position set includes two comparative-period non-accrual rows; the June 30, 2025 non-accrual schedule total of $34.80 million ties to five current-period rows, not seven.

rationale: The current-period performance table reports non-accrual amortized cost of $34.80 million as of June 30, 2025. That amount ties to five current SOI rows in table 9: Streamland ($9.742 million), Chase ($11.531 million), and three Wine.com Inc. rows ($0, $4.042 million, and $9.489 million). The flagged set has seven rows because it also includes comparative-period Lithium Technologies and a prior Chase Industries row from the December 31, 2024 SOI schedule, where the comparative non-accrual amount is $89.06 million. Therefore the flag reflects a real data error: comparative-period rows leaked into the report-date non-accrual position set.
